# TailorPic

> AI-powered professional headshot generator. Upload a few selfies, get studio-quality professional photos in minutes.

## About

TailorPic transforms everyday selfies into polished, professional headshots using AI. Multiple styles are available for business, LinkedIn, creative and personal use.

## Pricing

Plans start from $1.99 for a single photo, with packages up to 160 photos at $89.90. Team pricing available for groups of 5 or more.
